name: Data Parrot
description:
See which deals put your forecast at risk, what changed in your pipeline, which customers need attention, where reps need coaching, and why deals are won or lost, directly in the AI tools your team already uses.

Data Parrot brings its analysis and supporting details into your AI tools, so you can answer sales questions, create documents, and run workflows without explaining your business or rebuilding the analysis first.

Data Parrot learns how your company sells by combining HubSpot data with emails, calls, meetings, transcripts, and other connected activity.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Data Parrot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Data Parrot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-v3.dataparrot.ai/api/v3/data-parrot/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Data Parrot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Data Parrot provides these MCP tools: describe_data_catalog, expand_result, get_companies, get_data_parrot_access_status, get_deal, get_deal_timeline, get_deals, get_engagements, get_forecast, get_pipeline_history, get_win_loss, and switch_data_parrot_workspace.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Data Parrot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Data Parrot in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Data Parrot MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Data Parrot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Data Parrot is developed by Data Parrot. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
